counterfactual.rule: switch only when candidate cumulative work is strictly greater; retain incumbent on equality

partition_recovery.interpretation: No deterministic consensus failure was observed from the strict-greater-only counterfactual in this bounded sandbox run; the socket failures also occur under the unmodified rule and are treated as harness/runtime noise.

counterfactual.tradeoff: Equal-work nodes may temporarily retain different incumbents until one branch gains strictly more cumulative work; convergence therefore depends on subsequent work/propagation rather than an immediately global deterministic tie-break.
